buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Registered Office Criteria The Bidder must possess a legally registered and fully functional office within the State of Kerala. To valida te this, the bidder shall furnish a valid Goods and Services Tax (GST) registration certificate explicitly reflecting the registered office address in Kerala. 2. Technical Experience & Track Record The bidder must possess proven competence and relevant experience in the successful supply, inst allation, and commissioning of the items specified in this bid. The bidder shall attach documentary evidence comprising at least three (3) completion certificates or work order copies of a similar nature executed via the GeM portal within the State of Kerala durin g the Financial Years 2023-24, 2024-25, and 2025-26. Brand-Specific Proven Performance: The participating bidder/seller must have a documented hi story of successfully supplying products of the exact same proposed brand during the preceding thr ee (3) financial years. Legible and verifiable supporting documents—such as GeM invoices, contract award copies, or client satisfaction certificates—shall be submitted as definitive proof of such brand -specific compliance. 3. Local Service Support & Infrastructure To ensure prompt after-sales support and minimize equipment downtime, a fully operational authorized se rvice center must be available within the consignee’s district. The bidder shall submit valid address proof of the designated service center.

The service center must house certified and qualified engineers capable of providing comprehensive warranty and technical support. 4. Product Lifecycle & Validity The bidder shall propose only current, active, and non-obsolete OEM models. End-of-Life (EOL) or End-of-S upport (EOS) products will not be entertained. All offered hardware must carry active OEM warranty suppo rt from the date of final acceptance. 5. Completeness of Documentation Bidders are strictly required to compile and upload all requested certificates, undertakings, and supporting documents specified in the Bid Document, Additional Terms and Conditions (ATC), and subsequent Corrige ndums. Failure to upload any required document, or the submission of incomplete credentials, shall rende r the bid non-responsive and liable for immediate rejection during technical evaluation. 6. Quality Certifications To ensure compliance with statutory quality standards, both the participating Bidder and the respective pr oduct OEM must hold valid ISO certifications. Relevant, unexpired ISO certificates must be attached to the technical bid. 7. OEM Warranty, Support & Service Network The successful bidder must submit a formal OEM Warranty Certificate at the time of equipment deli very. The seller shall guarantee prompt rectification, troubleshooting, or component replacement at no a dditional cost during the entire stipulated warranty period. The OEM/Seller must possess a well-established, pan-India network for installation, commissioning, t raining, and after-sales service to assure prompt field support. 8. Self-Certification Mandate The bidder shall upload a formal Self-Certification statement confirming unconditional acceptance of, and strict adherence to, all terms, conditions, and clauses stipulated in this Additional Terms and Conditions (A TC) document. 9. Buyer’s Rights and Reserved Authority The Buyer reserves the unilateral right to accept or reject any bid, or annul the entire bidding process, bas ed on technical evaluation, independent market surveys, or the verifiability of the offered product specifica tions without assigning any reason thereof. 10. Established Platform Experience The bidder must demonstrate structural stability on the Government e-Marketplace by possessing a minim um of seven (7) years of continuous operational experience on the GeM platform. Valid documentary proof , such as the portal registration dashboard or initial order profiles, must be enclosed.

11. Manufacturer’s Authorization Form (MAF) The bidder must either be the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) or an explicitly authorized partner/d ealer of the proposed product line. Bidders representing an OEM must submit a valid, tender-specific Manu facturer’s Authorization Form (MAF) issued directly by the OEM on their official letterhead, validating auth orization for this specific procurement. 12. Comprehensive & All-Inclusive Pricing The financial quotation must be entirely all-inclusive. The bid price shall encompass the base cost of the ha rdware, logistics, delivery to the consignee site, standard installation, commissioning, and basic configurati on charges. No hidden or supplementary costs will be entertained post-award. 13. Strict Technical Compliance The technical specifications outlined in this tender constitute the absolute minimum essential requirement s. Bidders must ensure full compliance with these benchmarks and must append official, unaltered OEM pr oduct datasheets for rigorous technical cross-verification. 14. Non-Blacklisting Declaration The bidder must provide a formal self-declaration executed on the company’s official letterhead, solemnly affirming that the firm has not been blacklisted, suspended, or debarred by the GeM portal, or any Central/ State Government organization, within the preceding five (5) years. 15. GeM Seller Rating Benchmark To ensure high service standards, the participating bidder must maintain a minimum of a 4-star final GeM Seller Rating (LBL). A verifiable screenshot of the seller's rating profile from the GeM dashboard must be at tached as proof. 16. Business Volume Threshold The bidder must demonstrate strong fiscal capacity and market presence by having achieved a cumulative business volume of ₹10 Crore or above exclusively on the GeM platform. Supporting validation from the G eM dashboard or a verified order summary sheet must be uploaded. 17. Financial Capability & Business Turnover The bidder shall submit Chartered Accountant (CA)-certified financial turnover details explicitly covering th e last three consecutive financial years (FY 2023-24, FY 2024-25, and FY 2025-26) as definitive proof of fin ancial capability, structural stability, and reliable business performance. 18. Onsite Product Demonstration Following the opening of technical bids, the Buyer reserves the right to request a physical, onsite demonstr ation of the offered product models at the Buyer’s designated office. The bidder shall arrange the demonst ration within the stipulated timeframe at their own expense to verify operational conformity. 19. Preferred Brand & Quality Eligibility

To maintain infrastructural standardization, technical reliability, and seamless integration with existing inst itutional IT networks, the buyer requires established premium market brands. Specifically, offered product s must belong to reputed OEMs with a proven global and national enterprise presence, restricted to the foll owing: Acer, HP, or Dell. To ensure compliance with quality, durability, and standard component alignme nt, bids proposing unverified, minor assembly, or any brands other than those explicitly listed above will b e summarily rejected. . 3. Service & Support Availability of Service Centres: Bidder/OEM must have a Functional Service Centre in the State of each Consignee's Location in case of carry-in warranty. (Not applicable in case of goods having on-site warranty). If service center is not already there at the time of bidding, successful bidder / OEM shall have to establish one within 30 days of award of contract. Payment shall be released only after submission of documentary evidence of having Functional Service Centre.
